name: InbxGuard Email Deliverability Auditor for WooCommerce
author: ezzymd

sections.description:
Stop losing customer trust and sales because WooCommerce order confirmation, shipping notices, or password-reset emails silently land in customer spam folders.

InbxGuard Email Deliverability Auditor for WooCommerce runs automated, non-intrusive diagnostic checks against your store’s email authentication records and WooCommerce sender configuration. It evaluates your setup against 2024+ Gmail, Yahoo, and Outlook bulk sender requirements and gives you a clear Deliverability Health Score (0–100) with plain-English fixes.

Why You Need This

  • Silent Failures: Stores often have no idea that order emails are going to spam until frustrated customers complain.
  • Strict 2024+ Mail Requirements: Major mailbox providers (Google, Yahoo, Microsoft) now actively reject or spam-box unauthenticated emails sent from domains without proper SPF, DKIM, and DMARC alignment.
  • WooCommerce-Aware Context: Unlike generic DNS checkers, this plugin cross-references your DNS health directly with your WooCommerce email templates (Order Processing, Completed, Customer Invoice, Password Reset) to show you exactly which transactional emails are at risk.

Core Features

  • Instant Health Score (0–100): Visual animated score ring that rates your overall deliverability readiness.
  • SPF Record Audit: Verifies the existence and syntax of SPF records (v=spf1) on your sending domain.
  • DMARC Record Audit: Checks if _dmarc policy is published to protect your domain reputation.
  • DKIM Selector Probing: Checks common selector patterns (default, google, k1, mail, etc.) to detect DKIM signing status.
  • Sender Alignment Check: Confirms whether your WooCommerce “From” address domain matches your store domain.
  • Public Webmail Detector: Flags dangerous configurations (e.g. sending as @gmail.com or @yahoo.com), which trigger instant spam filters.
  • SMTP Provider Detection: Identifies if an authenticated SMTP/API mailer plugin is active (WP Mail SMTP, FluentSMTP, Post SMTP, etc.).
  • WooCommerce Email Risk Table: Assesses every registered WooCommerce transactional email and ranks customer-facing emails by risk level.
  • Actionable Step-by-Step Fixes: Plain-English instructions for resolving every detected warning or failure.
  • One-Click AJAX Re-Scan: Test DNS changes instantly without refreshing the page.
  • Lightweight & Secure: Zero frontend impact, transient-cached DNS lookups (6-hour TTL), rate-limited scanning, and strict capability checks.
  • HPOS Ready: Fully declared and compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the inbxguard-email-deliverability-auditor folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly via the WordPress Plugin Directory (Plugins → Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce → InbxGuard Email Audit in your admin menu to view your deliverability report and score.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send or alter my store’s emails?

No. InbxGuard Email Deliverability Auditor is strictly a read-only diagnostic and auditing tool. It inspects your DNS records and WooCommerce configuration to report issues, but does not alter your outgoing email content or sending flow.

Does this replace SMTP plugins like WP Mail SMTP or FluentSMTP?

No, it complements them. SMTP plugins handle how your email is sent through external mail servers. InbxGuard checks why emails might still land in spam (DNS authentication, SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment, and sender reputation rules).

What if my DKIM check shows a warning?

DKIM selectors are unique to your email provider (e.g. Google Workspace, Amazon SES, Brevo, SendGrid). The auditor checks the most common selector names automatically. If you use a custom selector, your emails may still be signed properly—simply verify the selector in your SMTP service dashboard.

Does running audits slow down my store?

Not at all. DNS lookup results are cached using WordPress transients for 6 hours, and re-scans are throttled to a maximum of once every 30 seconds. There is zero overhead on customer-facing store pages.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes! HPOS compatibility is officially declared and verified for modern WooCommerce releases (8.0+ through 9.3+).
